latency_scope: PC CPU int8/4 threads; decoder only, not phone capture/end-to-end
retrieval_type: SQLite menu documents + exact/alias/Hangul phonetic bigram retrieval; no generative LLM
evaluation_split: Even IDs development, odd IDs holdout. Only development error texts inspected for implementation; aggregate holdout scores observed. Single synthetic voice; no independent real-person test.
decision: Clean synthetic test passes provisional 95% gate; 15dB and 5dB noise fail 90% gate. Do not claim real-world readiness.
